summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Control Tower Shipment marketing site. All 6 backend pytest cases passed (POST /api/leads valid/minimal/422 invalid email/422 missing required + /api/status flow + root). All frontend flows validated end-to-end: landing hero + interactive world map + ship-item click highlight, demo modal open->fill->submit->demo-success, dashboard KPIs + status donut + ETA area chart + mode/country charts + filter-delayed filtering (1 row) + table-search filtering (1 row for CT-10188), open-CT-10188 navigation, and /shipment/CT-10188 detail page rendering DELAYED status, journey timeline, current-location map, exception panel, and events panel.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is instantiated AFTER _send_lead_email uses it (line 117 references logger before basicConfig at 162). NameError would occur if email fails during import time; move logging init above helpers.
No rate limiting / captcha on POST /api/leads — public endpoint could be spammed to trigger outbound Resend emails.
No unique index / de-dup on demo_leads (email+company) — duplicates possible.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 3 TEST_ leads and 1 TEST_client status_check via API during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py — reusable regression suite. Frontend data-testids are stable (hero-demo-btn, map-panel, ship-item-<id>, demo-name/company/email/submit/success, filter-<status>, table-search, row-<id>, open-<id>, shipment-header, journey-panel, exception-panel, events-panel). Demo data is mocked in /app/frontend/src/lib/data.js.
